title: epilobium glandulosum var. tenue
intro: Epilobium glandulosum var. tenue, commonly known as Willowherb or Willow-herb, is a plant species belonging to the willowherb family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which can help in reducing inflammation and fighting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Epilobium glandulosum var. tenue include acting as a diuretic, reducing blood pressure, and exerting antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
